announcements.headline: Completed sale of student accommodation properties
announcements.insight: The sale of student accommodation properties follows the November agreement. This disposal marks a key step in executing the previously agreed transaction.

announcements.headline: Agrees sale of student accommodation properties
announcements.insight: Sanctuary Capital PLC agrees to sell student accommodation properties. This follows its C1 rating by the Regulator of Social Housing and the 2025/26 Annual Financial Report.

announcements.headline: Sanctuary Group Annual Financial Report 2025/26
announcements.insight: Sanctuary Group Annual Financial Report 2025/26 is published following a C1 regulatory rating in May 2026. Shareholders should monitor how this financial performance aligns with the regulator's assessment.

announcements.headline: Sanctuary rated C1 by Regulator of Social Housing
announcements.insight: Sanctuary Capital PLC has been rated C1 by the Regulator of Social Housing. This regulatory rating may influence future operational constraints or strategic decisions for the company.
